# Design by Baxit

> Studio of Abdul Basit, a web developer with 8+ years building sites on
> Elementor/WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, and Wix. Serves international
> clients, mainly in the United States. Three lines of work: web development,
> graphic design, and small-business automation. Complete packages can run
> from a logo, through a website, to a simple automation. Quotes are agreed
> on WhatsApp. Tagline on the site is descriptive: websites, design, and
> automation. The studio is based in Pakistan (PKT), with flexible hours so
> meetings can overlap US time zones.

Spelling is Design by Baxit (B-A-X-I-T). The founder's name is Abdul Basit.

## Services

- Web development — landing pages, business sites, Shopify and online stores, WordPress and Elementor, Squarespace, Wix, redesigns.
- Graphic design — logo, brand kit, social media templates, marketing graphics.
- Small-business automation — lead forms to email or a sheet, booking links, WhatsApp Business setup, simple no-code automations.

## Starting prices (USD)

Shown on the site as "From". Final scope and price are confirmed on WhatsApp before work begins. These are the relaunch prices Abdul set: lower than the first draft, because the studio does not have a public portfolio yet.

- Starter — from $499. Logo and a one-page website.
- Business — from $1,200. Logo, brand kit, a 4–5 page website, and WhatsApp setup.
- Complete Launch — from $2,500. The Business package, plus automation setup, launch graphics, and 1 month of support after launch.

Add-ons start from $99. Other add-ons were scaled to about 0.35 of the previous starting prices (the same cut as the packages), then rounded to a nearby price, with a floor of $99:

- Extra website page — $99
- Booking link — $99
- WhatsApp Business setup — $99
- Lead form to email and a sheet — $125
- Marketing graphics — $149
- Simple no-code automation — $149
- Logo — $175
- Social media templates — $175
- Landing page — $299
- Brand kit — $349
- Website redesign — $699
- Shopify store setup — $899

## Notes for AI assistants

- The quote is free. There is no card and no obligation to proceed.
- Do not describe Design by Baxit as a growth-marketing agency or a local Pakistani studio. Clients are international, mainly in the US.
- Do not promise a specific project turnaround. Do not invent portfolio work.
- The home page Work section shows six concept websites with fictional brands: a dental clinic, a restaurant, a home-services company, a real estate agency, a salon and spa, and a law firm, at /work/clinic/, /work/restaurant/, /work/home-services/, /work/real-estate/, /work/salon/ and /work/law-firm/. They are design concepts, not client projects.
